text:
Meera_CS: Heads up — MeridianAI pilot in APAC spiked this morning during integration tests. They hit 5x expected RPS and started getting 429s. Renewal check-in next month, want to avoid churn. Can we do a short-term rate lift + add their colocated CIDR to allowlist? They'd like APAC region routing too.

Kai_engineer: Can you paste the CIDR and a rough time window? We can add temporary allowlist and bump rate window to 4x for 48h. Also confirm if traffic should route to apac-east or apac-sg cluster.

Meera_CS: CIDR 203.0.113.0/24. Window: from now until 2024-12-15 18:00 UTC (48h). Prefer apac-sg. Customer is ok with temporary dedicated burst if needed.

Tom_infra: I'll add the CIDR to the edge allowlist and create a specific routing rule to apac-sg. Doing these two now; will post config change ID. ETA ~15m.

config-bot: CHANGELOG: allowlist add 203.0.113.0/24 by tom_infra at 2024-12-13T14:22Z — rule id allow-85521. Route apac-sg pinned for MeridianAI — route id rt-3342.

Kai_engineer: Rate window bumped to 4x for tenant meridianai (tenant id: mer-998). Limits: token RPS soft 120 -> 480, hard 600. Bump expires 2024-12-15T18:00Z. Monitor dashboards for latency regressions.

Sophie_ops: Noted renewal risk. I'll schedule a quick enablement call with them tomorrow 09:00 SGT to walk best practices (batching, prefix caching). Also capturing feedback: they reported poorer latency on long-context prompts.

Meera_CS: Awesome, thanks team. Can someone drop a short summary for the customer with the change ids and expiry so I can send it?

Tom_infra: Pasting summary for you to forward:

- Allowlist: 203.0.113.0/24 (allow-85521)
- Routed region: apac-sg (rt-3342)
- Temporary rate increase: 4x soft limit until 2024-12-15T18:00Z (bump id: bump-4437)

Kai_engineer: We'll keep an eye on error rates and token latency. If they need sustained capacity beyond the window, recommend moving to Dedicated pool (discuss on call).

Meera_CS: Sending now. Thanks all :pray:
